resources.title: Excel Skills for Business: Essentials by Macquarie University on Coursera

practice_tasks: Complete modules on Excel formulas, VLOOKUP, and Pivot Tables.
Perform missing value imputation and data type correction on a messy dataset from Kaggle.
Calculate mean, median, standard deviation, and basic probability on a sample dataset.

resources.title: DataCamp Introduction to ETL and Data Engineering

practice_tasks: Write intermediate SQL queries including JOINs, GROUP BY, and subqueries using LeetCode or Mode.
Design a simple conceptual ETL pipeline diagram extracting CSV data, transforming fields, and loading into a relational schema.
Build a multi-sheet interactive dashboard in Tableau Public using a public dataset.
Perform basic CRUD operations and JSON document queries in MongoDB.
Review core concepts of A/B testing, metric selection, and sample size calculation.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Joy of Code

practice_tasks: Initialize a Git repository, commit code changes, create branches, and push to GitHub.
Set up an AWS free tier account, launch an Amazon S3 bucket, and upload a processed dataset.
